notes: Memory scan is now on the Memories tab, where anyone actually looking at a list of memories already is — it was only on a character's own memories screen, which you reach through their profile. With a character selected in the filter chips it scans that one; with All selected it asks whose history to read. Editing arrived on the same screen: the cards in the Memories tab were still the old ones with only a star and a bin, so they now carry the pencil too, and tapping a memory opens it for editing wherever you are. They also show where each memory came from — from chat, memory scan, you wrote — alongside the character and the date. Editing from the Memories tab used to throw you onto the character's own screen when you saved; it stays where you were now. And the old pattern-matcher that watched for phrases like 'I like…' has been retired. It could not tell a fact from a pleasantry, so 'I like you guys so much' was filed forever as a memory, and again in a slightly different wording every time it was said, which is where lists full of near-identical entries came from. The model pass reads the same messages and knows the difference. Only 'my name is…' is still matched that way, because it also fills in your profile name.
